'''Gazzari''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was located in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]. Gazzari had a breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], but the planetary surface was inhospitable, due to the presence of [[Volcano/Legends|volcanoes]], tectonic activity and [[Acid rain/Legends|acid rain]].

==History==
Gazzari was studied during a number of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] surveys and later, during the [[Republic Dark Age]], was located on the frontier between the [[Daimanate]] and the [[Odionate]].

In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], it was the site of a major [[Battle of Gazzari|battle]] between [[Daiman]] and [[Odion]] which eventually culminated in a joint strike against Lord [[Ayanos Bactra|Bactra]] who was observing the conflict from orbit.
